recipe.build:
chmod +x gradlew
PROF_FILE=app/build/intermediates/binary_art_profile/release/compileReleaseArtProfile/baseline.prof
PROF_SHA1=d640929e529acad0785c8ca06cc13f073906dbe2
for _ in {1..10}; do
./gradlew clean assembleRelease --no-build-cache --no-configuration-cache --no-daemon
find . -name 'baseline.prof'
test -f "$PROF_FILE"
if [ "$( sha1sum "$PROF_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1 )" = "$PROF_SHA1" ]; then
break
fi
done
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-size 16 --pad-like-apksigner --replace app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
